description: Employee warning letter + legal-risk check — Draft a fair, factual employee warning (employee, issue; optional level verbal|written|final, prior steps, manager, company, improveDays default 30) with expectations, review date (business day), proportional consequences, support offered and an acknowledgment block. Offline checks: protected-class or protected-activity topics (FMLA, pregnancy, complaints, workers comp...) that raise retaliation risk, subjective wording (attitude, lazy), missing dates or counts, final warning without prior steps, invented numbers, with LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH legal risk. Not legal advice. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
